name: Venomancer: Alkahest keeps Shadra's Prayer healing past its original duration (#11095)
contract: Alkahest (504718) tooltip: extends the duration of Shadra's Prayer on its target by 9 sec (effect 1, EffectBasePoints 8999, EffectMiscValue 800870, the first rank of Shadra's Prayer). The spell is bound to spell_ascension_venomancer_ability, which turns the effect into a dummy and calls AscensionVenomancer::ExtendOwned.

Shadra's Prayer rank 10 (502947) has DurationIndex 106 (24 s) and a 3000 ms periodic heal, so the periodic effect is allowed GetMaxDuration() / amplitude = 8 ticks. Extending only the remaining duration, with MaxDuration unchanged whenever the remaining time plus 9 s stays under 24 s, kept the aura alive but stopped its ticks at 24 s, as reported in #11095.

Expected: Alkahest cast at about 20 s adds 9 s, so the aura lasts until about 33 s and the periodic heal ticks at about 27 s and 30 s. The ticks are counted from just after the original 24 s expiry until 31 s after the Prayer was applied. A control Venomancer who casts the same Prayer at the same moment without Alkahest gets none in that window.

steps.label: Shadra's Prayer on the Alkahest Venomancer
SETUP: the Alkahest Venomancer has Shadra's Prayer
SETUP: the control has Shadra's Prayer
Reach about 20 s into the 24 s Prayer
Alkahest adds 9 s to Shadra's Prayer
SETUP: the Alkahest cast was accepted
SETUP: the control's Prayer expires at its original 24 s
Let the control's last tick pass
DISCRIMINATING: the extended Prayer still ticks after its original expiry
CONTROL: without Alkahest the Prayer no longer ticks
